routing_policy.standing_rule: Use aiwf-orchestrator for every non-trivial task.
routing_policy.selection_rule: Select the smallest focused route and no more than four downstream skills.
routing_policy.conflict_rule: AGENTS.md and HANDOFF.md override generic skill guidance.

project_signals: Provider-portable Agent Skills and skills-only personal Codex plugin.
Referenced Python helpers must be bundled with their owning skill.

scenarios.use_when: Use for skill creation, metadata, routing, packaging, installation, or export.
project_guardrails: Keep helper scripts inside their owning skill.

scenarios.use_when: Use for repository changes, security boundaries, and release hygiene.
verification: Use repo-native tests and git diff checks.

scenarios.use_when: Use the guardrail plus no more than two focused security owners for an authorized security task.
project_guardrails: Require exact scope before active tests.
verification: Run focused negative tests and record residual risk.

scenarios.use_when: Use the focused business or platform skill and add security/privacy only when the task crosses those boundaries.
project_guardrails: Require approval for spend, publishing, account, or API writes.
verification: Verify current official program, API, platform, and policy sources.

scenarios.use_when: Use for shared private project state, six-turn recovery, and resource-aware parallel work.
project_guardrails: UI tests do not load a model.

scenarios.use_when: Use for source-backed research, provenance, durable findings, and local handoff.
verification: Validate the produced receipt before relying on it.

scenarios.use_when: Use the one language/version skill that matches the repository target.
project_guardrails: Inspect compiler and runtime versions before editing.
verification: Run the target interpreter, compiler, build, and focused tests.

scenarios.use_when: Use focused framework skills and add the connector skill only for cross-layer behavior.
verification: Run app-native checks plus endpoint or browser validation.

scenarios.use_when: Use for Android application, device, storage, and network work.
project_guardrails: Do not assume a phone can reach desktop loopback.
verification: Run Gradle checks and the relevant emulator or real-device smoke.

scenarios.use_when: Use for retrieval quality and persistent data contracts.
project_guardrails: Pin embedding dimensions and distance metrics.
verification: Run retrieval fixtures, migration tests, and evidence-grounding checks.

scenarios.use_when: Use for Windows-local environment and service diagnosis.
project_guardrails: Identify the real interpreter, process, port, and boundary first.
verification: Capture exact commands and runtime output.

scenarios.use_when: Use for model pipeline, loader, evaluation, and serving contracts.
project_guardrails: Do not assume one dtype or quant is universal.
Do not start heavy jobs without explicit approval.
verification: Use artifact preflight, bounded evals, and endpoint smokes.

scenarios.use_when: Use for NVIDIA code, SDK compatibility, and GPU runtime failures.
project_guardrails: Treat serialized engine plans as version, platform, device, and trust sensitive.
verification: Record driver, toolkit, library, framework, device, and smoke results.

scenarios.use_when: Use for physical-system architecture, simulation, embedded targets, and site readiness.
project_guardrails: Record units, frames, hardware revisions, hazards, and rollback.
verification: Use simulation, bench, network, and site gates appropriate to the risk.

scenarios.use_when: Use for service scoping and evidence-backed website work.
project_guardrails: Use the live site for current public claims.
verification: Check rendered pages, metadata, crawl controls, structured data, and source links.

scenarios.use_when: Use for design cleanup, generated-image QA, and explicitly requested AIWF voice.
verification: Render and inspect the final artifact.
